system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "What happened to the iOS app? Literally unusable after this last update. Going to have to cancel my subscription. which one of y’all should I switch to?"
Intent: technical_issue (iOS app unusable after update; considering cancellation.)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: Ask for device / OS / app version, suggest log-out -> restart -> log-in or reinstall, link to the relevant help article.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: churn_or_anger_risk; trigger phrase: 'Going to have to cancel'). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "Two updates to the iOS app since iPhone X launch and still no optimization... Beyond dissatisfied. Looks like I’ll be switching over to"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Evan! We just replied to your DM with more info. Check it out 🙂"
2. Customer: "Anyone else having trouble the iPhone app since the last update?"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there! What's happening exactly? Can you also let us know your iPhone's model and the iOS and Spotify versions you're on?"
3. Customer: "tired of iPad app. where did the queue go this time? CarPlay on iPhone? deleted-reinstalled nothing. premium for years but..."
   SpotifyCares: "1: Hey Remy! Tap the Now Playing bar, then the Play Queue button in the top-right corner to see what's on the queue. Read more about..."
4. Customer: "any idea when the app will be fixed? It’s up to date and I’m using the iOS version. Logging out is no help."
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Natalie. We had a little hiccup earlier, but everything should be running as smooth as Smooth Jazz now!"
5. Customer: "Your iOS app loads so slow I’m seconds from cancelling my subscription."
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Chris, that doesn't sound right. What device, iOS and Spotify versions is this happening on? We'll lend a hand"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
response: Hey there! I understand you're frustrated with the iOS app. Can you please DM us your device model, iOS version, and Spotify version you're using? We'll take a look and get back to you. If you need to switch, we can help you with that.
